title: The Landstar Link, Winter 2021
summary: Read about record-breaking LCAPP savings, virtual safety meetings, and awards of all kinds making headlines in the newest edition of Landstar’s Link newsletter.
body_markdown:
The Landstar Link, Winter 2021 newsletter is now available! In this issue, you'll read about:


- Virtual safety meetings for BCOs
- Landstar’s recent awards and recognitions
- The 2021-2022 Landstar Scholarship Fund
- Landstar’s Employees of the Year


#### [Click here or on the cover below to read the publication today.](https://cloud.3dissue.net/29953/29847/30285/48039/index.html?74349)
